name: Foil Front Wing X-Over V3 Atmo - Perf Series
subtitle: The easiest wing to learn on, progress with, and fly with confidence.
description:
Programme
The ideal front wing for beginners and those progressing in foil, with easy take-off, ultra-stable flight, gentle lift, and very reassuring behaviour across all disciplines.
Overview
The X-Over V3 Atmo Perf Series is the front wing that makes foiling accessible to everyone without compromising on sensation. It takes off early, offers stable flight, forgives mistakes, and gives you time to understand your balance.
It's the perfect wing for learning to fly in wing foil, surf foil, SUP foil, kite foil, wake foil, or dock start.
Its programme is based on three essential qualities: ease of take-off, stability in flight, and constant control. It doesn't pitch up abruptly, doesn't stall unexpectedly, and doesn't require an established technique to perform.
Its 6.4 aspect ratio offers very reliable behaviour. The wingspan is kept compact to facilitate control of the tilt and limit tip breaches. You can fly close to the surface, correct your mistakes, and maintain a real margin, which makes all the difference during the first sessions.
Its supportive and progressive profile allows for take-off at low speed without intense pumping. Once airborne, the enhanced glide gives more time to execute manoeuvres, work on transitions, discover the first surfs, and start pumping properly.
The pronounced dihedral provides confidence on the foil and in carving turns by keeping the tips away from the surface. The X-Over grips, pivots easily, and remains very predictable. It offers a smooth, readable, almost self-regulating feel that helps you progress without fear.
Built in the Perf Series, it makes the V3 Atmo standard accessible with optimised, robust, and high-performance fibreglass technology. Its V3 SuperLock self-tightening connection ensures a rigid and reliable assembly with only two screws under the front wing.
The X-Over V3 Atmo Perf Series is the obvious first foil: easy to learn, performant enough to progress, and stable enough to make you want to fly for a long time.
